Leisure Suit Larry?

↳ Posted by swisspiper on June 27th, 2004.

This would probably go nicely with the Battering Ram as the rhythm and phrasing are a bit similar.

↳ Posted by Dr. Dow on March 5th, 2008.

Larry The Beer Drinker, X:2

I was listening to Brenda Castle’s CD “Indeed you needn’t bother” and was reminded of the tune Larry the Beer Drinker and found it here. Playing through the first setting, I found myself hearing some slight differences from what I remember (maybe from Brenda’s playing, or, I think, an old recording from Stockton’s Wing). So I modified it to what I remember. I left the second part alone, because any variants there would be very minor.

↳ Posted by ithaca-markb on December 28th, 2017.
